name: Phasesteel Lattice
description: A woven mesh of semi-real metal used in advanced adaptive gear.
specialEffects: Core ingredient for crafting mobility-focused weapons and armor.

steps: Refine raw stock for Phasesteel Lattice under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Phasesteel Refinery protocol before storage.
